title: UE Blueprint Authoring
description: Inspect and edit authored Blueprint member variables, local SCS components, and event dispatchers with bounded readback and structural identity.

recipes.title: Inspect authored Blueprint structure
recipes.description: Read member variables, local SCS component hierarchy, graphs, and event dispatchers without claiming runtime or debugger state.

inputs.name: blueprint
inputs.description: Exact Blueprint asset path or name.

steps.purpose: Resolve the Blueprint identity, graphs, and member variables.
Page the graph, local SCS component, and event dispatcher inventories.
Re-read the structure and report pagination and authored-only boundaries.

result.summary: Bounded authored Blueprint structure with explicit non-runtime scope.
evidence: Blueprint, graph, component, and dispatcher identities
success: all pages and truncation were reported
authored state was not presented as runtime or debugger state

recipes.title: Edit Blueprint member variables
recipes.description: Add, remove, rename, or retype member variables with structural readback and collision rejection.

inputs.name: blueprint
inputs.description: Exact Blueprint asset path or name.

inputs.name: variableName
inputs.description: Current member variable name for rename/remove/retype.

inputs.name: newName
inputs.description: New member variable name for rename.

inputs.name: type
inputs.description: Target type for add or retype; consult the live schema.

inputs.name: value
inputs.description: Optional default value for add; scalar or object JSON.

steps.purpose: Read the current member variables and confirm the target identity.
Add, remove, rename, retype, or set metadata on the exact member variable.
Re-read the member variables and confirm the exact change and reference update.

result.summary: One approved member-variable change with structural and reference evidence.
evidence: member variable identity before and after
success: only the intended member variable changed
references were updated or a collision/invalid name was rejected

recipes.title: Edit local SCS components
recipes.description: Add, remove, reparent, or set a property on local SCS components with hierarchy readback and cycle rejection.

inputs.name: blueprint
inputs.description: Exact Blueprint asset path or name.

inputs.name: componentName
inputs.description: Local SCS component variable name.

inputs.name: componentNodeId
inputs.description: Local SCS VariableGuid; alternate to componentName.

inputs.name: newParentName
inputs.description: New local SCS parent variable name for reparent; omit to move to root.

inputs.name: property
inputs.description: Editable persistent property name for property.set.

inputs.name: value
inputs.description: Property value for property.set; scalar or object JSON.

steps.purpose: Read the current local SCS component hierarchy and resolve the target identity.
Add, remove, reparent, or set a property on the exact local SCS component.
Re-read the component hierarchy and confirm the exact change and child preservation.

result.summary: One approved local SCS component change with hierarchy readback evidence.
evidence: component identity and parent before and after
success: only the intended local SCS component changed
self-parenting and descendant cycles were rejected

recipes.title: Edit Blueprint Timelines
recipes.description: Create and inspect Timeline templates, add typed tracks, and replace validated float, vector, color, or event keyframes.

inputs.name: blueprint
inputs.description: Exact Blueprint asset path or name.

inputs.name: timelineName
inputs.description: Timeline template name.

inputs.name: trackName
inputs.description: Track name for track or key operations.

inputs.name: trackType
inputs.description: float, vector, color, or event.

inputs.name: keys
inputs.description: Up to 4096 validated key objects; use value for float, x/y/z for vector, r/g/b/a for color, and time for event.

steps.purpose: Read current Timeline templates and typed track data.
Create a Timeline, add a typed track, or replace a track's complete key set.
Re-read all typed tracks and keyframes after the authored edit.

result.summary: Bounded authored Timeline change with typed curve readback; compile/save and runtime behavior remain separate evidence.
success: invalid or duplicate key input was rejected before mutation
all four track types are readable after write

recipes.title: Inspect Blueprint CDO properties
recipes.description: Read bounded, typed nested CDO or UObject asset properties with inherited-property filtering.

inputs.name: asset
inputs.description: Blueprint or UObject asset path.

inputs.name: category
inputs.description: Optional category substring.

inputs.name: includeParentDefaults
inputs.description: Include inherited properties; default true.

inputs.name: maxProperties
inputs.description: Bound output to 1..4096 properties; default 1024.

steps.purpose: Resolve the asset and establish the authored CDO identity before serialization.
Serialize scalar, reference, struct, array, set, and map property values within output bounds.
Report the property bound, inheritance filter, and authored-only output boundary.

result.summary: Typed authored CDO property inventory with explicit pagination bound and inherited-property policy.
evidence: property type, owner, category, value, replicated/edit-const flags
success: nested JSON values are bounded and no runtime state is inferred

recipes.title: Set a Blueprint CDO property
recipes.description: Change one writable generated-class default from JSON, with a transaction, optional compile/save, and explicit old/new readback.

inputs.name: asset
inputs.description: Blueprint or UObject asset path.

inputs.name: property
inputs.description: Exact reflected property name; case-insensitive fallback is supported.

inputs.name: value
inputs.description: Scalar, object, or array JSON value accepted by the reflected property.

inputs.name: saveOnSuccess
inputs.description: Request compile and save after the in-memory change; defaults to the workflow save policy.

steps.purpose: Read the current CDO properties and resolve the exact writable property before mutation.
Apply one JSON property value inside the native editor transaction; transient, deprecated, edit-const, and disabled-on-instance properties are rejected.
Read the CDO again and compare the property identity and serialized value; report saved state separately from in-memory authoring.

result.summary: One authored Blueprint CDO default change with explicit old/new values and persistence boundary.
evidence: property name and old/new exported values
success: invalid property or JSON value was rejected before a committed change
the readback matches the requested authored value
save failure is reported separately from an in-memory mutation

recipes.title: Duplicate a Blueprint graph or copy its nodes
recipes.description: Export the structural graph with stable GUIDs, then duplicate a graph or copy nodes between graphs and read back the compiled node counts.

inputs.name: blueprint
inputs.description: Exact Blueprint asset package or object path.

inputs.name: graph
inputs.description: Optional source graph name or object path for export/duplicate; defaults to the primary event graph.

inputs.name: newName
inputs.description: Optional display name for the duplicated graph; defaults to <source>_Copy.

inputs.name: sourceGraph
inputs.description: Source graph name or object path to copy nodes from.

inputs.name: targetGraph
inputs.description: Target graph name or object path to copy nodes into.

steps.purpose: Export the full structural graph with stable node/pin GUIDs to resolve source and target identities.
Duplicate one graph or copy all nodes between graphs once; both compile and read back node counts.
Re-export the target graph and confirm the node count and re-wired internal links.

result.summary: One authored graph duplicate or node copy with structural and compile readback evidence.
evidence: compiled node counts before and after
success: only a non-transient /Game/ Blueprint was written
the duplicated graph or copied node set was read back
export queries never compiled or saved

recipes.title: Create a typed DataAsset or raw UObject asset
recipes.description: Create one native or plugin UObject instance under /Game, register it with the Asset Registry, and verify the authored class identity and save result.

inputs.name: savePath
inputs.description: New /Game package path without an object suffix.

inputs.name: className
inputs.description: Loaded native or plugin UObject class name or full /Script path.

inputs.name: asset
inputs.description: Bind this to the object_path returned by blueprint.data_asset.create before the verify step, for example /Game/Data/DA_Example.DA_Example.

inputs.name: skipSave
inputs.description: Keep the package dirty in memory instead of saving it.

steps.purpose: Discover the loaded native or plugin class catalog before the write; className selects the intended class and the create operation rejects Blueprint, Actor, abstract, deprecated, and superseded classes before mutation.
Create and register exactly one raw UObject/DataAsset at the requested /Game package path, optionally saving it.

Bind asset to execute.object_path, then read the new object's reflected properties and compare class identity, package path, Asset Registry registration, dirty/save state, and explicit authored-only scope.

result.summary: One registered native or plugin UObject/DataAsset with explicit class and persistence evidence.
success: the requested package did not already exist
unsupported class categories were rejected before mutation
the created object can be resolved by blueprint.cdo.properties.get

recipes.title: Batch spawn Blueprint actors
recipes.description: Spawn a bounded set of Blueprint actors in a grid or linear layout with one undo transaction and per-actor readback.

inputs.name: blueprint
inputs.description: Blueprint asset or generated class path.

inputs.name: count
inputs.description: Number of actors from 1 through 1000.

inputs.name: pattern
inputs.description: grid or linear; defaults to grid.

inputs.name: origin
inputs.description: Origin vector as [x,y,z] or {x,y,z}.

inputs.name: spacing
inputs.description: Positive grid or linear spacing in Unreal units.

inputs.name: columns
inputs.description: Grid columns, from 1 through 1000.

inputs.name: direction
inputs.description: Linear direction vector.

inputs.name: rotation
inputs.description: Shared rotation vector.

inputs.name: scale
inputs.description: Shared scale vector.

inputs.name: labelPrefix
inputs.description: Optional label prefix; entries use prefix_0, prefix_1, and so on.

inputs.name: folder
inputs.description: Optional Outliner folder.

inputs.name: properties
inputs.description: Optional scalar actor properties.

inputs.name: tags
inputs.description: Optional string tags applied to every actor.

inputs.name: sublevel
inputs.description: Optional loaded streaming level name.

inputs.name: mobility
inputs.description: static, stationary, or movable root component mobility.

inputs.name: select
inputs.description: Select actors after spawn; defaults to false.

steps.purpose: Resolve the current Blueprint package or generated class path from the recipe's blueprint input and establish its authored package state before spawning.
Spawn the requested bounded grid or linear batch in one transaction and apply shared metadata.
Use the returned actor identities, locations, counts, and failure list as authored world readback.

result.summary: Bounded Blueprint actor batch with explicit partial-failure and world-state readback.
success: count and layout inputs were bounded
all successful actors are reported
partial failures remain visible and do not invalidate the whole transaction
